newsitem.title: USA: First Data Q1 internal revs grow 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: First Data Q1 internal revs grow 15 pct.

text.p: First Data Corp said on Tuesday that its internal revenues grew 15 percent in the first quarter.

Total first quarter revenues of $1.29 billion reflect the divestitures of MoneyGram Payment Systems Inc in late 1996 and GENEX, a health care workers compensation subsidiary, in early 1997, First Data said.
First quarter domestic card issuer services revenues increased 45 percent, including recent acquisitions, the company said.
Domestic card issuer services would have increased by 32 percent without the benefits of acquiring Donnelley Marketing and Hogan Information Systems, First Data said.

Total domestic accounts on file increased 22 percent to 136 million accounts at quarter end, reflecting the conversion of Chase Manhattan accounts in late 1996 and growth of existing clients, First Data said.

First quarter revenues in credit application processing, customer service, and collections services were up 96 percent, and information-based services revenues increased 69 percent, excluding acquisitions.
Payment instrument revenues, including Western Union, were $299 million for the quarter, up 23 percent, First Data said.
